Financing Class for Compass Agents

A straightforward look at what is actually getting buyers approved right now.

When
Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 10:00 AM MT
How long
45 minutes, including live Q&A
Where
Live on Zoom
Cost

Save my seat

What this covers

Forty-five minutes, no fluff. We go through the loan programs and structures that are moving deals in this market, what a strong pre-approval looks like, and how to keep a file from falling apart between contract and closing.

  • Where rates and buydowns actually stand, and how to explain them to a buyer without overpromising
  • Conventional, FHA, and VA side by side, and which one fits which buyer
  • What separates a pre-approval that holds up from one that does not
  • Seller concessions and temporary buydowns: when they help and when they cost your buyer money
  • The three things that most often blow up a file after contract, and how to catch them early

Who it is for

  • Compass agents working with buyers in today's rate environment
  • Agents who want a lender they can put on the phone with a client mid-showing
  • Anyone who has lost a deal to a financing surprise in the last year
